subject: Discovery recap + implementation action list for Aurelia POC
messages:
From: Jonas Weber <jonas.weber@redwood.com>
To: Alex Rivera <alex.rivera@aurelia.com>, Priya Shah <priya.shah@aurelia.com>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa.cole@redwood.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwood.com>
Date: Sat, 15 Aug 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Discovery recap + implementation action list for Aurelia POC

Hi Alex & Priya — thanks again for the call this morning. Quick recap and proposed next steps so we’re all aligned before the trial kickoff.

Recap (what we heard)
- Goal: Evaluate real-time clinical note summarization and structured extraction across 3 pilot clinics (estimated 2000 notes/day).
- Success criteria you prioritized: 1) >92% entity recall for meds/diagnoses on our evaluation set, 2) median 95th percentile response latency < 350ms for single-note streaming, 3) integration work completed within 3 weeks of kickoff.
- Data flows: customer-hosted PHI in VPC (we will run Redwood Private), connectivity via mTLS to a dedicated gateway, audit logs required for SOC2 evidence.

POC scope we propose
- Week 0: Kickoff + environment provision (VPC peering, KMS key exchange).
- Week 1: SDK integration and simple ingestion route; produce streaming inference for single-note use case.
- Week 2: Evaluate batch reprocessing and prefix caching; run evaluation suite and produce metrics.
- Week 3: Validation, handoff to Aurelia devs, and acceptance check.

Immediate asks from Aurelia (please confirm)
1) Provide a small sample of 150 anonymized notes for our acceptance test by Tue 8/18.
2) Confirm the list of required entities for extraction (we logged: meds, dose, frequency, diagnosis codes, procedure codes).
3) Confirm PKI contact for mTLS cert exchange.

Technical integration notes (high level)
- SDKs: Use our python SDK (pip install redwood-infer). Primary route: POST /v1/infer/stream for streaming token-level responses; fallback: POST /v1/infer/sync for batch jobs.
- Tool calling: We'll expose a structured JSON schema for entity output and provide a tool-calling wrapper for your orchestration (we suggested a webhook for post-processing).
- Observability: we will enable per-route token/latency tracing in the Console and provide the audit log bundle for SOC evidence.

Attachments: I’m attaching a one-sheet with the proposed success criteria and a short runtime integration checklist.

Proposed next meeting: Technical kickoff (45min) on Thu 8/20 10:00–10:45 PT — please confirm.

Thanks,
Jonas
Jonas Weber

- Week 1–2 (8/27–9/9): Integration window — SDK routes, streaming route testing (POST /v1/infer/stream), tool-calling webhook for structured extraction, and prefix/KV caching validation.
- Week 3 (9/10–9/16): Evaluation runs, scoring, and acceptance.
